title: Tanvi, Shaina Advance to World Junior Championships Round of 32
indian_angle: Indian singles players Tanvi Patri and Shaina Manimuthu secured impressive victories to move into the round of 32 at the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: Tanvi Patri defeated Anastasija Kichayeva 15-6, 15-10, while Shaina Manimuthu beat Chih-Yun Cheng 15-6, 15-10, showcasing strong performances by India's junior talent on the international stage.

title: Sindhu, Lakshya Face Tough Draws at Denmark Open
indian_angle: India's top shuttlers PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen are set for challenging opening matches against formidable opponents at the upcoming Denmark Open.
summary: PV Sindhu is set to clash with her rival An Se-young, while Lakshya Sen will face a tough test against Chou Tien-chen in their respective opening rounds at the Denmark Open.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee, a significant step for player representation in Indian badminton.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) officially formed its Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, aiming to provide a stronger voice for players in the sport's governance.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's junior badminton prospects are honing their skills at a national coaching camp in Guwahati, preparing for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: A national coaching camp for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati on September 24, 2026, to prepare India's young talent.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Adopted for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
summary: Effective June 30, 2026, the BAI will use a 3x15 scoring system in all domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for the U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories to enhance junior competition.
